_comment: Game actions in menu order (Esc -> Settings -> Controls). keys: the default keys, up to 'slots' per action, by Godot key name (OS.find_keycode_from_string), matched as physical keys. pad: pad buttons (not remapped yet). fixed: keys that always stay on the action and can't be bound elsewhere (Esc also cancels a rebind). The player's own keys are saved under 'controls' in user://settings.json.
_tools: One 'pick tool N' action per tool in Game.TOOLS, after the actions above; tool_label gets the slot number and the tool's name, tool_keys gives the defaults in slot order.
